site.sitedescription: Moor located on the southwestern slope of Mt. Gorin in the northeastern Chugoku Mountans. Moor a complex of open water with Nymphaea tetragona, Cyperaceae fen, and Sphagnum moorland. Overstory vegetation is Ilex crenata and Symplocos coreana. Upland vegetation around the moor dominatd by Cryptomeria japonica and Larix leptolepis, also deciduous forest with Fagus crenata, Quercus mongolica var. grosseserrata, Sorbus commixta, and Acer crataegifolium.
